notes.title: [PROJECT NOVA] GAMEMODES!
notes.content: [h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Revamped User Interface[/b]: Completely overhauled the game's UI for a more aesthetic and functional experience, improving navigation and visual appeal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapon - LA-87[/b]: Introduced the LA-87 weapon, fully functional and textured, with final animations and sounds still in progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapon - LP-12[/b]: Added the LP-12 weapon, completed but awaiting final setup and ultimate ability implementation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Game Mode - Team Deathmatch[/b]: Introduced Team Deathmatch mode, now available for players to enjoy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Menu and Win Screen Map[/b]: Added a new menu and win screen map for a refreshed post-game experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skin System Development[/b]: Began work on skins; in the next update, match winners will receive a crown during the following match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality of Life Feedback Sounds[/b]: Added several new audio cues to enhance gameplay feedback and immersion.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Backend Optimization[/b]: Significant backend improvements to ensure a smoother and more reliable gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement System Overhaul[/b]: Completely remade the movement system to retain higher momentum, enabling faster-paced and more dynamic gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Additional minor changes and bug fixes may have been included in this update to improve overall stability and performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Stay tuned for further updates on the LA-87 animations, LP-12 ultimate, and skin system enhancements![/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: - Revamped User Interface: Completely overhauled the game's UI for a more aesthetic and functional experience, improving navigation and visual appeal.
- New Weapon - LA-87: Introduced the LA-87 weapon, fully functional and textured, with final animations and sounds still in progress.
- New Weapon - LP-12: Added the LP-12 weapon, completed but awaiting final setup and ultimate ability implementation.
- New Game Mode - Team Deathmatch: Introduced Team Deathmatch mode, now available for players to enjoy.
- New Menu and Win Screen Map: Added a new menu and win screen map for a refreshed post-game experience.
- Skin System Development: Began work on skins; in the next update, match winners will receive a crown during the following match.
- Quality of Life Feedback Sounds: Added several new audio cues to enhance gameplay feedback and immersion.
- Movement System Overhaul: Completely remade the movement system to retain higher momentum, enabling faster-paced and more dynamic gameplay.

notes.title: [Project Nova] Pre-Beta
notes.content:
[b][h1]Thank you all for playing and being interested on the game, Please Share it as it helps a lot!
[/h1][/b]
[h2][Poject Nova] Pre-Beta Update
[/h2]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chat (Press enter to chat)
[*] New Player Model 
[*] Hands!
[*] UI reworked
[*] More Keybind options
[*] Some Maps Changed
[/list]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[list]
[*] LR-01 Ultimate: Payback, Charge your ultimate by getting kills and release a powerful shot that can kill up to 6 players at once!
[*] LS-50 Scope: Quickscope, A scope truly design for a fast paced game, When first aiming you'll get a damage boost and piercing on you shot, But be aware the longer you aim the weaker your shot
[*] New Maps
[*] LK-99 Slice your enemies, what more can you ask?
[*] Healing Pads
[/list]

[h1]Developer Notes[/h1]
This patch note does not describe all changes made to the game since last version
I changed a lot of stuff and fixed even more, I do not remember all the changes, but I'll try to keep track from now on
